entrypoint.reason: The program reads its inputs from fixed repository paths and does not accept or validate a scheduler task-input file.

repository_snapshot.format: JSON document or json_document_store sharded document
JSON document or json_document_store sharded document
repository_snapshot.purpose: previous assessment history and rotation cursor

remote_inputs.repository_binding: URL owner/repository must match the candidate repository
remote_inputs.redirect_policy: final response must remain HTTPS on raw.githubusercontent.com

environment.other_environment_inputs: None identified in reviewed main() path

stdout_json.meaning: Run summary only; does not prove downstream source activation.

document_store_side_effects: For each write_document logical document, JSON storage may atomically replace the base file.
For sharded documents it may create <logical-name>.manifest.json and <logical-name>.parts-<content-digest>/part-*.jsonl.
After the new manifest becomes authoritative it may delete older <logical-name>.parts-* directories.
Temporary staging directories and temporary files may be created and removed.

protected_paths.shadowrocket/ss.conf: not read or written by this entrypoint
protected_paths.sources/domain_sources.json: not written; assessment does not activate sources

resource_contract.lock_scope_note: The logical document lease must cover its adjacent manifest, all content-addressed shard directories, staging files, atomic replacement, and old-shard cleanup.

execution_semantics.idempotency_key: Not implemented; cursor rotation and assessed_at timestamps change persisted state.
execution_semantics.retry_policy: No automatic retry until cursor/checkpoint recovery and write-resource lease semantics are implemented.
execution_semantics.timeout_note: Current maximum of 5,000 URLs with per-request network timeout does not establish a safe total runtime bound; benchmark and explicit batch-size input are required.
success_predicate: stdout is exactly one parseable JSON object with all required fields.
persistent and runtime assessment documents pass schema and shard-integrity verification.
execution_semantics.independent_verifier: Not implemented; required before dispatch can be enabled.

dependency_edges.edge_semantics: assess_sources consumes the discovered_sources snapshot produced by discover_sources; it does not dispatch that predecessor itself.
dependency_edges.note: The dependency must become a scheduler-enforced artifact dependency with snapshot identity, not merely a workflow ordering assumption.

permission_boundary.filesystem: Write only the three declared logical output resources and their document-store temporary/manifest/shard children.
permission_boundary.network: HTTPS raw.githubusercontent.com only, repository-bound URL and same-host redirect checks.
permission_boundary.github_api: No direct GitHub API write or token grant.
permission_boundary.protected_config: shadowrocket/ss.conf is immutable and outside this capability's write set.

blockers: No runtime resource lease or fencing token enforcement.
No stable idempotency key or checkpoint-aware retry semantics.
No measured total runtime bound for the configured 5,000-URL batch.

review_context.note: This is a review-context pointer, not a dispatch authorization or claim that all runtime guarantees are implemented.
